channel.title: The Kyiv Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Kyiv Independent (kyivindependent.com)

item.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,239,590 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
item.description: The number includes 880 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

item.title: Defense Ministry working with SpaceX to solve Russian use of Starlink on drones
item.description: Ukraine says it is working with SpaceX to stop Russian drones from using Starlink, after reports that satellite-connected UAVs are extending their range to strike deeper into Ukrainian territory.

item.title: At least 5 killed, 19 injured in Russian attacks over past day
item.description: The Air Force said on Jan. 31 that Russia launched 85 drones against Ukraine overnight, of which 55 were Shahed-type drones. It said that it had downed 64 drones in the north, south, and east of the country.

item.title: 'Russians are to blame' — Moldovans react to mass power outage after Moldova-Ukraine line malfunction
item.description: Moldova suffered a major power outage on Jan. 31, leaving most of its capital without electricity in the morning and halting trolleybuses and traffic lights. Parts of Moldova experienced power disruptions when Ukraine reported "a cascade shutdown" in its power grid due to technical malfunctions on high-voltage lines

item.title: Russian officials call for 'more powerful weapons' to attack Ukraine as temperatures drop
item.description: Russian State Duma Chairman Vyacheslav Volodin's threat comes a few days after Ukrainian, Russian, and U.S. officials held the latest round of peace talks in Abu Dhabi on Jan. 23-24.

item.title: Russian envoy meets US officials for Ukraine peace talks before next round of trilateral negotiations
item.description: Russian Envoy Kirill Dmitriev held "productive and constructive meetings" with U.S. officials in Miami, U.S. Special Envoy Steve Witkoff said on Jan. 31.

item.title: Poland closes airspace after Belarusian balloon incursion
item.description: Polish authorities temporarily closed the airspace along the northern part of Poland's border with Belarus overnight on Jan. 30-31 after unidentified objects — believed to be Belarusian smuggling balloons — were detected in the region.

item.title: Over 168,000 Russian soldiers killed in Ukraine identified by media investigation
item.description: Since the media outlets' last update in mid-January, the names of 4,536 Russian soldiers have been added to the list of casualties.

item.title: 'Everyone in shock' – Kyiv residents left without power, heating, and water as grid disruption causes mass blackout across Ukraine
item.description: Energy Minister Denys Shmyhal reported "a cascade shutdown" in Ukraine's power grid in the morning on Jan. 31.
